integrity: Proved analytically for all stated parameters. Finite software checks cross-check rather than certify the universal statements; original source is credited for the metric and existence theory.
scientific_limitations: The phase-shift quotient uses time-normalized curves, not arc-length reparametrization or spatial rotation. Exactly two mean classes is asserted for two-lobe harmonic inputs only. Higher-harmonic nonuniqueness criterion is sufficient; the two inputs may be limit cycles of different flows.
title: A sharp bifurcation of phase-aligned means of embedded periodic orbits
